findings.statement: The D061 and D063 scientific movement is real within the declared matched-resolution scope, not a documentation-only gate flip. The retained module hash is exactly 760a7c04..., the four D060-D063 report hashes match the ledgers, D060->D061 has exactly 17 JSON leaf deltas confined to contract/wall/verdict and the adjudicated N7X gating metadata, and D062->D063 retains the base endpoint and holdout while changing the two declared discriminator domains. D063 records a fresh full endpoint, holdout, block/spectrum checks, coupled-energy check, and two killed sign mutants. No production or Rust physics file changed in D057..HEAD. Acceptance steelman: prospective reissues, immutable FAIL receipts, hashes, pinned libraries/threads, and exact permitted diffs make this materially stronger than D055/D056. Rejection steelman: it remains one platform, same-model authorship, post-failure discriminator redesign, and was not scientifically re-executed in this audit. findings.statement: The D064 closeout is not anti-inflation or cost-policy compliant. D057..HEAD touches 148 paths and adds 21469/deletes 85/net +21384 text lines; D058-D064 alone touches 93 paths and adds 16297/deletes 75/net +16222. The latter consists of 10686 tracked-run lines, 4320 scientific audit-script lines, 620 audit-document lines, 401 harness code/test lines, and 192 SSOT/context net lines, with zero production-source lines. The r3/r4 covariance scripts share 1512 exact lines (99.5% of r3); the r2/r3 trajectory scripts share 610 (98.5%); their paired contracts share 109 and 111 exact lines. Four report JSON files totaling 114287 bytes occur verbatim again inside their stdout logs. D064, the validation ledger, and the D058-D064 project-state overlays contain none of the mandatory added/deleted/net/token/BMR/cost lines. Strong acceptance steelman: the chain closes real validation blockers and preserves raw failures. Strong rejection steelman: Git history already preserves superseded scripts/contracts, one result is stored twice, and no deflation or mandatory accounting accompanies repeated >400-line commits. Cost line for this audited chain: added_lines 21469; deleted_lines 85; net_lines +21384; files_touched 148; token_use_exact UNAVAILABLE because no reliable stage counter; runtime_behavior_changed yes for harness and no for production; physics_behavior_changed no; known_blocker_reduced yes; blocker_movement_ratio 0.75 because hard validation blockers closed but no previously impossible production path was created; validation_strengthened yes; cost_effectiveness_verdict DRIFT.
assumptions_used: Git line counts include all text surfaces and exclude the two binary pyc deletions from added/deleted totals.
Raw failure preservation does not require retaining a full duplicate executable when the exact blob remains in Git history.
The repository policy applies to scientific validation PRs and docs/run artifacts, not only production source.

findings.statement: D058 fixes the demonstrated ACTIVE_RUN race only when the Start-time lease is successfully written; it is not globally fail-closed. subagent_start_context.py catches lease-write OSError, labels the lease unavailable, and continues with explicit ACTIVE_RUN fallback. subagent_stop_validate.py then binds to the mutable active pointer whenever no lease exists. In addition, the lease seals every assignment registered in the run rather than the single parent-launched assignment, so Stop accepts whichever sealed assignment_id the agent self-declares if the main-side prompt/write audit is absent or wrong. The current 12/12 fixtures pass and correctly cover successful lease, corrupt lease, moved pointer, and assignment tamper, but do not cover lease-write failure or intra-run assignment substitution. Acceptance steelman: the actual D058 live overlapping-run canary recorded a lease and passed its exact target, and parent-side launch admission is the documented VS Code workaround. Rejection steelman: a fail-closed integrity gate cannot silently degrade to the exact mutable-pointer authority that D057 invalidated, and self-attested assignment selection is not automatic assignment binding. Therefore G-HARNESS-INTEGRITY cannot be unconditional PASS; at most the successful-lease path is VALIDATED.
assumptions_used: Fail-closed means a failed mandatory lease write must stop substantive execution rather than re-enable mutable global authority.
Automatic assignment integrity requires a parent-authenticated agent-to-assignment binding, not only a lease containing all assignment hashes.
Parent-side manual prompt and write hashing is useful defense but does not make an automatically unenforced path equivalent to hook enforcement.
unresolved: Make lease-write failure a Start preflight error with no ACTIVE_RUN fallback for post-D058 agents.
Bind one assignment_id and digest to each launched agent in a parent-created lease or signed launch receipt.
Add negative fixtures for lease-write failure and same-run assignment substitution, then run a live overlapping-main replacement canary.

New audit and harness code requires its own focused validation rather than retroactive coverage by a Rust release run.
